description: A traditional red-breasted robin with light-up chest - the perfect ornament for your windowsill, mantlepiece, or tabletop this Christmas. 3 LED lights illuminate the acorn-detailed garland necklace. Glitter finish. Comes boxed. Polyresin. H14 x W18.5 x D14cm. Design may vary. Requires 2 x AAA batteries (not included). AAA batteries are available in packs of 10 on code 13459 for only £3 / €3.60.
